key: It's such a good day for a swim!
en: It's such a good day for a swim!
ja: 泳ぐには最高の日ね!

key: It's a good day for a battle, too!
en: It's a good day for a battle, too!
ja: バトルするにも最高の日だ!

key: I'm so glad the lake has cleared up.
en: I'm so glad the lake has cleared up.
ja: 湖がきれいになったのが本当にうれしいわ。

key: Nothing like a battle on the water!
en: Nothing like a battle on the water!
ja: 水上でのバトルに勝るものはないぜ!

key: I got washed away!
en: I got washed away!
ja: 流されちゃったよ!

key: Man, I missed this lake.
en: Man, I missed this lake.
ja: いやあ、この湖が恋しかったな。

key: I really enjoy spending time with you.
en: I really enjoy spending time with you.
ja: 君と過ごす時間、本当に楽しんでるよ。

key: Let's do this again really soon, yeah?
en: Let's do this again really soon, yeah?
ja: またすぐこうしようね?

key: As for tonight... we could always go back to my place.
en: As for tonight... we could always go back to my place.
ja: 今夜はさ……あたしの部屋に戻ってもいいけど。

key: <>- Grandview Avenue\n^ - 4th Street
en: <>- Grandview Avenue\n^ - 4th Street
ja: <>- グランドビュー通り\n^ -4番街

key: Azurine Lake is back, my friend.
en: Azurine Lake is back, my friend.
ja: アズリン湖が戻ってきたな、友よ。

key: Never thought I'd see the day.
en: Never thought I'd see the day.
ja: こんな日が来るとは思わなかった。

key: It's nice to finally get out for once.
en: It's nice to finally get out for once.
ja: たまには外に出るのもいいものね。

key: It had uh, been a while.
en: It had uh, been a while.
ja: その、しばらくぶりだったし。

key: Thank you for coming with me.
en: Thank you for coming with me.
ja: 一緒に来てくれてありがとう。

key: No matter how clean a city is, a girl's still gotta make a living.
en: No matter how clean a city is, a girl's still gotta make a living.
ja: 街がどんなにきれいになろうと、女だって生活していかなきゃならないのよ。

key: And as the quality of life goes up, so does its cost.
en: And as the quality of life goes up, so does its cost.
ja: それに、生活の質が上がれば、その分お金もかかるようになる。

key: Pah. All these uppity folks be on this community shit.
en: Pah. All these uppity folks be on this community shit.
ja: はっ、うるさい連中がみんなコミュニティがどうとか言い出しやがって。

key: This ain't my community. It's just a hole I landed into.
en: This ain't my community. It's just a hole I landed into.
ja: これはあたしのコミュニティなんかじゃない。ただ流れ着いた穴ぐらってだけ。

key: And no matter how shiny it is, it's still the pits.
en: And no matter how shiny it is, it's still the pits.
ja: どんなにピカピカにしたって、しょせんはどん底さ。

key: When all the city's a garden, how can anyone appreciate the flowers that bloom brightest?
en: When all the city's a garden, how can anyone appreciate the flowers that bloom brightest?
ja: 街全体が花畑になったら、一番鮮やかに咲く花を誰が見分けられるっていうの?

key: Ah well. I will always appreciate myself.
en: Ah well. I will always appreciate myself.
ja: まあいいわ。あたしは自分自身をいつだって大切にするから。

key: Home of the official Name Rater
en: Home of the official Name Rater
ja: 公式ネームレーターの店

key: Grandview Station is still under reconstruction.
en: Grandview Station is still under reconstruction.
ja: グランドビュー駅は現在再建中です。

key: Check back soon for when we finally reopen!
en: Check back soon for when we finally reopen!
ja: 開業までもうしばらくお待ちください!

key: Now this place is the sort that I've always dreamed of!
en: Now this place is the sort that I've always dreamed of!
ja: この場所こそ、ずっと夢に見てきた場所そのものだ!

key: City's teamwork makes the citizens' dreams work!
en: City's teamwork makes the citizens' dreams work!
ja: 街のチームワークが市民の夢をかなえるんだ!

key: Hello! If you're interested in helping with the city's reconstruction, make sure to report to the Grand Hall!
en: Hello! If you're interested in helping with the city's reconstruction, make sure to report to the Grand Hall!
ja: こんにちは!街の復興を手伝ってくれる気があるなら、ぜひ大ホールに報告してください!

key: Welcome, friend!
en: Welcome, friend!
ja: ようこそ、友よ!

key: This place has picked up quite a lot. Make sure to keep it clean when you leave!
en: This place has picked up quite a lot. Make sure to keep it clean when you leave!
ja: この場所もずいぶんきれいになっただろう?帰る時はちゃんと片づけていってくれよな!

key: I just came here on the first train I could!
en: I just came here on the first train I could!
ja: 来られる一番早い電車でここまで来たの!

key: I heard Reborn had a great League, so I had to come try it.
en: I heard Reborn had a great League, so I had to come try it.
ja: リボーンにはすごいリーグがあるって聞いたから、挑戦しに来ないわけにいかなくて。

key: Hey, what's the Champion like?
en: Hey, what's the Champion like?
ja: ねえ、チャンピオンってどんな人なの?

key: SEACREST: Welcome, my friend!
en: SEACREST: Welcome, my friend!
ja: シークレスト: ようこそ、我が友よ!

key: It's been quite some time, hasn't it?
en: It's been quite some time, hasn't it?
ja: ずいぶん久しぶりですね?

key: I've learned much since I last saw you.
en: I've learned much since I last saw you.
ja: 前に会った時から、私も多くを学びました。

key: Back then, I was always intent on keeping my garden closed off to preserve it.
en: Back then, I was always intent on keeping my garden closed off to preserve it.
ja: あの頃の私は、庭を守るためにずっと閉ざしておくことばかり考えていました。

key: Ah, but now I understand it is much better to let serenity out, so it may infect the world and thereby heal it.
en: Ah, but now I understand it is much better to let serenity out, so it may infect the world and thereby heal it.
ja: ですが今は、静けさを外へ解き放つ方がずっと良いのだと分かるのです――そうすれば、それが世界に広がり、世界を癒すのですから。

key: After learning this from young Adrienn--
en: After learning this from young Adrienn--
ja: 若きアドリエンヌからそれを学んだあと――

key: Not a day older than I remember xem, I swear--
en: Not a day older than I remember xem, I swear--
ja: 記憶の中の姿から一日たりとも歳をとっていないと思うのですが――

key: I besought xem to let me tend to the public gardens all over this city.
en: I besought xem to let me tend to the public gardens all over this city.
ja: 私は懇願したのです、街中の公共の庭園を手入れさせてほしいと。

key: All of us together...
en: All of us together...
ja: 皆で力を合わせて……

key: We've truly been able to make this city flourish.
en: We've truly been able to make this city flourish.
ja: 本当にこの街を花開かせることができました。

key: SEACREST: Welcome, Trainer.
en: SEACREST: Welcome, Trainer.
ja: シークレスト: ようこそ、トレーナーさん。

key: I am in charge of the city's public garden and park areas. You may call me Mr. Seacrest.
en: I am in charge of the city's public garden and park areas. You may call me Mr. Seacrest.
ja: 私はこの街の公共庭園と公園を管理しております。シークレストとお呼びください。

key: Please enjoy the city gardens with respect and care.
en: Please enjoy the city gardens with respect and care.
ja: どうかこの街の庭園を大切に、心を込めてお楽しみください。

key: Actually, there is something you can help me with.
en: Actually, there is something you can help me with.
ja: 実は、一つお手伝いいただきたいことがあるのです。

key: We've gotten ourselves into an unfortunate situation here.
en: We've gotten ourselves into an unfortunate situation here.
ja: 少々困った状況になってしまいましてね。

key: See, my amnesiac worker over there was supposed to deliver some mulch to me, so that we could continue working.
en: See, my amnesiac worker over there was supposed to deliver some mulch to me, so that we could continue working.
ja: 実は、あちらにいる記憶喪失の作業員が、堆肥を私のもとへ届けるはずだったのですが、そうして初めて作業を続けられるのです。

key: Unfortunately it seems that, of four bags, he's managed to lose every single one in his travels across the city.
en: Unfortunately it seems that, of four bags, he's managed to lose every single one in his travels across the city.
ja: どうやら4袋のうち、街を歩き回るうちに全部なくしてしまったようでして。

key: From the sound of it, you probably won't see them laying around, but if you do find them, please bring them to me.
en: From the sound of it, you probably won't see them laying around, but if you do find them, please bring them to me.
ja: おそらくそのまま転がっているようなことはないでしょうが、もし見つけたら、私のもとへ届けていただけますか。

key: He also might be able to give you some idea of where they could be.
en: He also might be able to give you some idea of where they could be.
ja: 彼に聞けば、どこに行ったかの手がかりも得られるかもしれません。

key: SEACREST: Oh! I see you found the Growth Mulch. I'll take it off your hands.
en: SEACREST: Oh! I see you found the Growth Mulch. I'll take it off your hands.
ja: シークレスト: おお!すくすくこやしを見つけてくれたのですね。お預かりします。

key: \PN handed over the Growth Mulch.
en: \PN handed over the Growth Mulch.
ja: \PNはすくすくこやしを渡した。

key: SEACREST: Oh! I see you found the Gooey Mulch. I'll take it off your hands.
en: SEACREST: Oh! I see you found the Gooey Mulch. I'll take it off your hands.
ja: シークレスト: おお!ねばねばこやしを見つけてくれたのですね。お預かりします。

key: \PN handed over the Gooey Mulch.
en: \PN handed over the Gooey Mulch.
ja: \PNはねばねばこやしを渡した。

key: SEACREST: Oh! I see you found the Damp Mulch. I'll take it off your hands.
en: SEACREST: Oh! I see you found the Damp Mulch. I'll take it off your hands.
ja: シークレスト: おお!じめじめこやしを見つけてくれたのですね。お預かりします。

key: \PN handed over the Damp Mulch.
en: \PN handed over the Damp Mulch.
ja: \PNはじめじめこやしを渡した。

key: SEACREST: Oh! I see you found the Stable Mulch. I'll take it off your hands.
en: SEACREST: Oh! I see you found the Stable Mulch. I'll take it off your hands.
ja: シークレスト: おお!ながながこやしを見つけてくれたのですね。お預かりします。

key: \PN handed over the Stable Mulch.
en: \PN handed over the Stable Mulch.
ja: \PNはながながこやしを渡した。

key: SEACREST: My amnesiac worker over there was supposed to deliver some mulch to me so that we could continue working.
en: SEACREST: My amnesiac worker over there was supposed to deliver some mulch to me so that we could continue working.
ja: シークレスト: あちらの記憶喪失の作業員は、堆肥を私のもとへ届けて、作業を続けるはずだったのです。

key: SEACREST: Oh! So that's everything!
en: SEACREST: Oh! So that's everything!
ja: シークレスト: おお!それで全部そろいましたね!

key: You're quite competent, young Trainer.
en: You're quite competent, young Trainer.
ja: あなたはなかなか有能なトレーナーですね。

key: I hope it wasn't too much trouble. Please take this as my thanks.
en: I hope it wasn't too much trouble. Please take this as my thanks.
ja: ご面倒をおかけしたことでしょう。これを感謝の印にどうぞ。

key: SEACREST: I found that when we were cleaning up an area to work in.
en: SEACREST: I found that when we were cleaning up an area to work in.
ja: シークレスト: それは、あの一帯を片づけて作業場を作っていた時に見つけたものです。

key: Hopefully someone as adventurous as you can find a use for it.
en: Hopefully someone as adventurous as you can find a use for it.
ja: あなたのような冒険心のある方なら、きっと使い道が見つかるでしょう。

key: Hmm... Take this, too.
en: Hmm... Take this, too.
ja: うーむ……これもお受け取りください。

key: SEACREST: I suspect you'll get more use out of that than I ever will.
en: SEACREST: I suspect you'll get more use out of that than I ever will.
ja: シークレスト: 私よりも、あなたの方がずっと役立てられるでしょう。

key: Good luck on your travels, Trainer.
en: Good luck on your travels, Trainer.
ja: 旅の無事をお祈りしています、トレーナーさん。

key: SEACREST: When I was young, I was all about fighting and exploration.
en: SEACREST: When I was young, I was all about fighting and exploration.
ja: シークレスト: 若い頃の私は、戦いと探検のことばかり考えていました。

key: I thought, "What kind of person could spend all their time just looking after plants? How boring!"
en: I thought, "What kind of person could spend all their time just looking after plants? How boring!"
ja: 「ただ植物の世話に一生を費やすなんて、どんな人間なんだ?なんて退屈な」と思っていたものです。

key: Sometimes I wonder if my younger self would be disappointed in me,
en: Sometimes I wonder if my younger self would be disappointed in me,
ja: 時々、若い頃の自分が今の私を見たら失望するのではないかと思うこともあります。

key: But I think he would be surprised to learn that something simple like this can bring a greater satisfaction than any thrill he ever sought.
en: But I think he would be surprised to learn that something simple like this can bring a greater satisfaction than any thrill he ever sought.
ja: ですが、彼が求めていたどんなスリルよりも、こうした単純なことの方が大きな満足をもたらすと知ったなら、きっと驚くでしょうね。

key: Ah-- I guess he did learn that in the end, didn't he?
en: Ah-- I guess he did learn that in the end, didn't he?
ja: ああ……結局、彼はそれを学んだということなのでしょうね?

key: Oh, and by the way, we recently found this.
en: Oh, and by the way, we recently found this.
ja: ああ、それと、最近こちらを見つけましてね。

key: SEACREST: Hopefully you can use that?
en: SEACREST: Hopefully you can use that?
ja: シークレスト: これも役立てていただけるとうれしいのですが。

key: Hail, Trainer.
en: Hail, Trainer.
ja: よう、トレーナー。

key: City watch is on the look-out for trouble. If you see anything suspicious, please report it to us.
en: City watch is on the look-out for trouble. If you see anything suspicious, please report it to us.
ja: 自警団はトラブルに目を光らせています。不審なものを見かけたら、私たちに知らせてください。

key: Now open for tickets outside Reborn City."
en: Now open for tickets outside Reborn City."
ja: リボーンシティ外への切符、発売中。」

key: Hey, Trainer. Can I help you?
en: Hey, Trainer. Can I help you?
ja: よう、トレーナー。何か用か?

key: I'm just tryna enjoy my break here, you feel?
en: I'm just tryna enjoy my break here, you feel?
ja: ここでちょっと休憩してるだけなんだよ、わかるだろ?

key: Gotta stay cool. You should know about that.
en: Gotta stay cool. You should know about that.
ja: クールでいなきゃな。お前さんも知ってるだろうけど。

key: Ugh, I've already checked everywhere I can remember being...
en: Ugh, I've already checked everywhere I can remember being...
ja: ああ、思い出せる場所は全部見て回ったのに……

key: Not that that's very many places.
en: Not that that's very many places.
ja: といっても、そんなに多くの場所じゃないけどな。

key: I can't believe I apparently lost all of the mulch I was supposed to bring...
en: I can't believe I apparently lost all of the mulch I was supposed to bring...
ja: 運ばなきゃいけなかった堆肥を、全部なくしちまったなんて信じられないよ……

key: Well, I definitely didn't leave the city, and I don't think I went in any buildings.
en: Well, I definitely didn't leave the city, and I don't think I went in any buildings.
ja: まあ街の外には出てないし、建物の中にも入ってないと思うんだけどな。

key: I can't remember exactly where I went, but I'm guessing if it was for work, it was probably mostly around park and garden areas.
en: I can't remember exactly where I went, but I'm guessing if it was for work, it was probably mostly around park and garden areas.
ja: どこを歩いたか正確には思い出せないけど、仕事だったなら、たぶん公園や庭園の周りが多かったはずだ。

key: Sigh... Maybe I should just go buy an Itemfinder.
en: Sigh... Maybe I should just go buy an Itemfinder.
ja: はぁ……ダウジングマシンでも買いに行った方がいいのかな。

key: Hey, weren't you the one that cleaned out Team Meteor?
en: Hey, weren't you the one that cleaned out Team Meteor?
ja: なあ、お前ってチームメテオを一掃したやつだろ?

key: Man, I thought my problems were big.
en: Man, I thought my problems were big.
ja: いやあ、自分の悩みなんて大したことないと思ってたよ。

key: Thanks for doing us all that favor.
en: Thanks for doing us all that favor.
ja: みんなのためにあれをやってくれて助かったよ。

key: You want these?
en: You want these?
ja: これ、いる?

key: Oh, thanks for picking up my mess!
en: Oh, thanks for picking up my mess!
ja: おっ、おれの散らかしたもんを片づけてくれたのか、ありがとな!

key: I got this when I was trying to backtrack and find the mulch myself, but I can't even remember what it is.
en: I got this when I was trying to backtrack and find the mulch myself, but I can't even remember what it is.
ja: これは自分で堆肥を探そうと後戻りしてた時に拾ったんだけど、何なのか自分でもよく分からないんだ。

key: Maybe you could use it instead?
en: Maybe you could use it instead?
ja: 代わりにお前が使えるかもな?

key: Maybe I should just start writing everywhere I go down...
en: Maybe I should just start writing everywhere I go down...
ja: 行った場所を全部書き留めておいた方がいいのかもな……

key: My life's been much easier ever since my neighbors helped patch our house.
en: My life's been much easier ever since my neighbors helped patch our house.
ja: 近所の人たちが家を修理してくれてから、おれの人生はずっと楽になったよ。

key: I was going to repay the favor, but their other neighbors beat me to it.
en: I was going to repay the favor, but their other neighbors beat me to it.
ja: その恩を返そうと思ってたんだけど、他の近所の人たちに先を越されちまってさ。

key: Ah well, what's a guy to do?
en: Ah well, what's a guy to do?
ja: まあいいさ、しょうがないよな。

key: Oh? They need help in Coral?
en: Oh? They need help in Coral?
ja: ん?コーラルで人手が必要なのか?

key: Hmm. What comes around must go around.
en: Hmm. What comes around must go around.
ja: ふむ。巡り巡って戻ってくるってやつだな。

key: Seems like it's my turn after all.
en: Seems like it's my turn after all.
ja: 今度はおれの番みたいだ。

key: "Neo-Circuit Power Plant- A Silph Co. Service."
en: "Neo-Circuit Power Plant- A Silph Co. Service."
ja: 「ネオサーキット発電所―シルフカンパニー提供施設」

key: There's something written underneath.
en: There's something written underneath.
ja: 下に何か書いてある。

key: "Neo-Circuit is such a LAME name! I officially retitle this place the Electro-Dazzle Happy Boom-Time House of Cheer!"
en: "Neo-Circuit is such a LAME name! I officially retitle this place the Electro-Dazzle Happy Boom-Time House of Cheer!"
ja: 「ネオサーキットなんてダサすぎる名前!ここを正式に『エレクトロ・ダズル・ハッピー・ブームタイム・ハウス・オブ・チアー』と改名する!」

key: JASMI: Reborn really is an inspiring place.
en: JASMI: Reborn really is an inspiring place.
ja: ジャスミ: リボーンって本当に胸を打たれる場所ね。

key: Through the efforts of many, we've watched this region blossom into something truly beautiful.
en: Through the efforts of many, we've watched this region blossom into something truly beautiful.
ja: 大勢の努力のおかげで、この地方が本当に美しく花開いていくのを見てきたわ。

key: It's quite uplifting, seeing how much difference a few years can make.
en: It's quite uplifting, seeing how much difference a few years can make.
ja: ほんの数年でこれほどの違いが生まれるなんて、すごく勇気づけられる。

key: Despite its problems, this city will always have a special place in my heart.
en: Despite its problems, this city will always have a special place in my heart.
ja: 色々問題はあっても、この街はいつまでもあたしの心の特別な場所であり続けるわ。

key: And so will you.
en: And so will you.
ja: そしてあなたもね。

key: KELVIN: ...Did that sound a bit cheesy?
en: KELVIN: ...Did that sound a bit cheesy?
ja: ケルビン: ……今の、ちょっとキザすぎたか?

key: JASMI: Maybe a little bit.
en: JASMI: Maybe a little bit.
ja: ジャスミ: ちょっとだけね。

key: I finally earned my first Badge a bit ago!
en: I finally earned my first Badge a bit ago!
ja: さっき最初のバッジを取ったの!

key: Now I've gotta train up for Florinia.
en: Now I've gotta train up for Florinia.
ja: これからフロリニアに向けて鍛えないと。

key: Ugggh, but there aren't any good spots to grind, are there?
en: Ugggh, but there aren't any good spots to grind, are there?
ja: うう、でもレベル上げにいい場所なんてあるのかな?

key: What a suspicious box...
en: What a suspicious box...
ja: なんだか怪しい箱ね……

key: ...y, are you okay?!
en: ...y, are you okay?!
ja: ……い、大丈夫!?

key: Wake up!
en: Wake up!
ja: 起きて!

key: VICTORIA: Thank goodness, you're alive...
en: VICTORIA: Thank goodness, you're alive...
ja: ヴィクトリア: よかった、生きてる……

key: I just found you passed out here...
en: I just found you passed out here...
ja: ここで気を失ってるのを見つけたの……

key: Do you have any idea how long it's been!?
en: Do you have any idea how long it's been!?
ja: どれだけ経ったか分かってるの!?

key: We thought you were gone forever!
en: We thought you were gone forever!
ja: もう二度と会えないかもって思ってたのよ!

key: And now you just show up, sleeping in the middle of the pavement?
en: And now you just show up, sleeping in the middle of the pavement?
ja: それが今になって、道の真ん中で寝転がって現れるなんて?

key: Geez...
en: Geez...
ja: もう、まったく……

key: Anna told us everything that happened--
en: Anna told us everything that happened--
ja: アンナが何があったか全部話してくれたわ――

key: How you defeated Lin finally, and how the real Lin is still hiding out there somewhere in the New World.
en: How you defeated Lin finally, and how the real Lin is still hiding out there somewhere in the New World.
ja: あんたがついにリンを倒したこと、それに本物のリンが今も新世界のどこかに隠れていること。

key: Listen, it's been crazy.
en: Listen, it's been crazy.
ja: 聞いて、本当に色々あったのよ。

key: A lot's been going on, but we're trying to work on it together.
en: A lot's been going on, but we're trying to work on it together.
ja: 大変なことがたくさん起きてるけど、みんなで力を合わせて対処しようとしてるの。

key: Meet up at the Nightclub in North Obsidia, okay?
en: Meet up at the Nightclub in North Obsidia, okay?
ja: 北オブシディアのナイトクラブで集合しましょう、いい?

key: Arc's been ring-leading the efforts to deal with this, so I'm sure we can better explain everything there.
en: Arc's been ring-leading the efforts to deal with this, so I'm sure we can better explain everything there.
ja: アークがこの件の対応を仕切ってくれてるから、そこできっとちゃんと説明できると思う。

key: I'll meet up with you later too, but for now I...
en: I'll meet up with you later too, but for now I...
ja: あたしも後で合流するけど、今のところは……

key: Paperwork...
en: Paperwork...
ja: 書類仕事……

key: There's always... so much... paperwork...
en: There's always... so much... paperwork...
ja: いつだって……終わらない……書類仕事……

key: I'll just tie up a few loose ends and be over when I can, okay?
en: I'll just tie up a few loose ends and be over when I can, okay?
ja: いくつか片づけたらすぐ向かうから、いい?

key: See you later at the Nightclub!
en: See you later at the Nightclub!
ja: またあとでナイトクラブでね!

key: VICTORIA: Oh, and--
en: VICTORIA: Oh, and--
ja: ヴィクトリア: ああ、それと――

key: I'm so glad you're back.
en: I'm so glad you're back.
ja: あんたが戻ってきてくれて、本当にうれしい。

key: Thank you...
en: Thank you...
ja: ありがとう……

key: ADRIENN: Thank goodness, you're alive...
en: ADRIENN: Thank goodness, you're alive...
ja: アドリエンヌ: よかった、生きていて……

key: It seems like that last excursion gave you some trouble?
en: It seems like that last excursion gave you some trouble?
ja: どうやら最後の遠征でひどい目に遭ったようですね?

key: Like you were stuck in some kind of bad dream still...
en: Like you were stuck in some kind of bad dream still...
ja: まるでずっと悪い夢の中に閉じ込められていたかのような……

key: To be honest, I'm always a little bit worried that something will happen to either of us again.
en: To be honest, I'm always a little bit worried that something will happen to either of us again.
ja: 正直に言うと、あなたか私、どちらかにまた何か起きるのではと、いつも少し心配なんです。

key: Something like falling forward another decade, or disappearing like you did before...
en: Something like falling forward another decade, or disappearing like you did before...
ja: 十年先に飛ばされるとか、以前のように消えてしまうとか……

key: I can't even express how relieved I am to see you back again.
en: I can't even express how relieved I am to see you back again.
ja: あなたが戻ってきてくれて、どれほど安心しているか言葉にできません。

key: Take whatever time you need to rest.
en: Take whatever time you need to rest.
ja: 必要なだけ休んでください。

key: This region needs its Champion in shipshape!
en: This region needs its Champion in shipshape!
ja: この地方には万全な状態のチャンピオンが必要ですから!

key: If you're all right, I should hurry back to the Nightclub though.
en: If you're all right, I should hurry back to the Nightclub though.
ja: 大丈夫そうなら、私はナイトクラブへ急いで戻らなければ。

key: I was only meant to be taking a brief walk to clear my head before returning to business.
en: I was only meant to be taking a brief walk to clear my head before returning to business.
ja: 仕事に戻る前に、少し散歩をして頭を整理するだけのつもりだったので。

key: As always, please let me know if there's anything you require.
en: As always, please let me know if there's anything you require.
ja: いつも通り、何か必要なことがあれば教えてください。

key: You have mine and all of the region's fullest support behind you,
en: You have mine and all of the region's fullest support behind you,
ja: 私も、そしてこの地方全体も、あなたを全面的に支えています、

key: As any good Champion should.
en: As any good Champion should.
ja: 立派なチャンピオンにふさわしく。

key: Friend!
en: Friend!
ja: 友よ!

key: Do you remember me? It's been so long!
en: Do you remember me? It's been so long!
ja: あたしのこと、覚えてる?もうずいぶん経ったね!

key: You helped me find a home when I had none.
en: You helped me find a home when I had none.
ja: 何もなかったあたしに、居場所を見つけてくれたよね。

key: It is true, I was planning to leave this place as soon as I could.
en: It is true, I was planning to leave this place as soon as I could.
ja: 本当は、できるだけ早くこの場所を離れるつもりだったんだ。

key: And now, Grandview Station is finally open...
en: And now, Grandview Station is finally open...
ja: そして今、グランドビュー駅がついに開業したわ……

key: But I have decided to stay!
en: But I have decided to stay!
ja: でも、あたしはここに残ることに決めた!

key: Your kindness, and that of this city, have shown me this is a better place to be anyway.
en: Your kindness, and that of this city, have shown me this is a better place to be anyway.
ja: あんたの優しさと、この街の優しさが、ここの方がずっといい場所だって教えてくれたから。

key: That old shack you found me was hardly a home until one day a fellow named Adrienn knocked on it.
en: That old shack you found me was hardly a home until one day a fellow named Adrienn knocked on it.
ja: あんたが見つけてくれたあの古い小屋は、アドリエンヌって人が扉をノックするまで、ろくに家とも言えなかった。

key: That person laid out their plans, and you can see what has become of them!
en: That person laid out their plans, and you can see what has become of them!
ja: その人が計画を打ち出して――結果がどうなったか、あんたにも分かるでしょ!

key: Not a bad investment, and I was all too happy to help them rebuild other parts of the city in return!
en: Not a bad investment, and I was all too happy to help them rebuild other parts of the city in return!
ja: 悪くない投資だったし、お返しに街の他の場所の復興を手伝えて本当にうれしかった!

key: So, Reborn is my home now!
en: So, Reborn is my home now!
ja: だから、リボーンが今のあたしの家なの!

key: And I will not forget you, friend.
en: And I will not forget you, friend.
ja: そして、あんたのことは絶対に忘れない、友よ。

key: I want you to have this as one last token of my thanks!
en: I want you to have this as one last token of my thanks!
ja: これを最後の感謝の印として受け取ってほしいの!

key: I hope you have been taking good care of my Onix as well!
en: I hope you have been taking good care of my Onix as well!
ja: あたしのイワークのことも、ちゃんと大事にしてくれてるといいな!

key: Be strong! Reborn does not break, nor do its people!
en: Be strong! Reborn does not break, nor do its people!
ja: 強くあれ!リボーンは壊れない、その民もね!

key: I hope you have been taking good care of my Onix!
en: I hope you have been taking good care of my Onix!
ja: あたしのイワークのこと、ちゃんと大事にしてくれてるといいな!

key: KELVIN: Boy, Reborn City sure has been through a lot, huh?
en: KELVIN: Boy, Reborn City sure has been through a lot, huh?
ja: ケルビン: いやあ、リボーンシティも本当に色々あったよな?

key: But then again, I suppose we have too.
en: But then again, I suppose we have too.
ja: でもまあ、おれたちもそうだったか。

key: I'm grateful to this city.
en: I'm grateful to this city.
ja: この街には感謝してるよ。

key: After all, if I hadn't come here to Reborn, then I would never have met you, Jasmi.
en: After all, if I hadn't come here to Reborn, then I would never have met you, Jasmi.
ja: だってさ、ここリボーンに来なかったら、ジャスミ、君に出会うことはなかったんだから。

key: I think I'm ready for us to start our next big adventure together.
en: I think I'm ready for us to start our next big adventure together.
ja: これからおれたちの次の大冒険を始める準備ができた気がするよ。

key: Those of us who ain't got nowhere to be still got to be somewhere.
en: Those of us who ain't got nowhere to be still got to be somewhere.
ja: 行く当てのないあたしらだって、どこかにはいなきゃならない。

key: But I'll appreciate it being a nice place like this.
en: But I'll appreciate it being a nice place like this.
ja: だったら、こういう素敵な場所であることに感謝するさ。

key: Dreams can come true after all.
en: Dreams can come true after all.
ja: 夢は結局かなうもんなんだな。

key: With the help of all of our neighbors, I was able to transform this small oasis into a resort.
en: With the help of all of our neighbors, I was able to transform this small oasis into a resort.
ja: 近所の皆さんの助けを借りて、この小さなオアシスをリゾートに変えることができました。

key: I will always be thankful for that.
en: I will always be thankful for that.
ja: そのことにはいつまでも感謝します。
